channel.title: LoomSci - Artificial Intelligence
channel.description: Latest Artificial Intelligence articles from LoomSci

item.title: From Pixels to Newtons: Learning Force Without Physics
item.description: A transformer predicts three-dimensional hip and knee contact forces from a single monocular video, matching physics-based models without modeling muscles or Newton's laws.

item.title: Reading Genomes as Documents: An OCR Approach to DNA Understanding
item.description: A vision-language model reads DNA as an OCR-processed document, compressing genomic information into visual tokens for efficient, layout-aware analysis.

item.title: Learning to Trust a Crowd of Almost-Right Models
item.description: In Rashomon Partition Sets, the data support a crowd of almost-right models, forcing researchers to confront what is robust and what is fragile.

item.title: Sparsity Defeats Separation: High-Dimensional Expanders Refute Steurer’s Conjecture
item.description: High-dimensional expanders defeat the intuition that low average correlation forces large separated clusters, refuting a decade-old conjecture by Steurer.

item.title: What If a Neural Network Could Simulate Physics Without Equations?
item.description: A transformer-based neural network learns to simulate fluid dynamics, shock waves, and thermal convection directly from data, without any governing equations.

item.title: When a Neural Network Learns to Respect the Shape of Space
item.description: By integrating the cell complex's incidence structure directly into neural message passing, the cellular sheaf neural operator ensures that magnetic fields remain divergence-free by construction.

item.title: Shielding Robots from Their Own Language: A Passivity Protocol
item.description: A passivity shield and energy tank decouple a VLA robot's semantic commands from its physical authority, ensuring safe contact-rich manipulation.

item.title: When Coordinates Learn the Product Rule
item.description: DeepMDMD learns coordinates that form a closed algebra, preserving the product rule and turning nonlinear dynamics into linear eigenfunctions.

item.title: When AI Outruns Blame: The Accountability Horizon
item.description: The Accountability Horizon marks a phase transition where causal chains from human decisions to AI outcomes become logically impossible to assign, reshaping governance.

item.title: Entanglement Unlocks Exponential Capacity Growth in Communications
item.description: Quantum entanglement allows distributed transmitters to coordinate in real time, turning chaotic interference into exponential capacity gains for classical communication networks.

item.title: When AI Safety Withholds the Cure
item.description: When AI safety gates life-saving medical advice, only doctors receive the full answer; patients face withheld knowledge and silent refusal.

item.title: Breaking the Exponential Barrier: Clustering Non-Spherical Gaussians in Polynomial Time
item.description: A polynomial-time sum-of-squares projection separates overlapping non-spherical Gaussian clusters by compressing them into a cleanly separable low-dimensional space.
